faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Vivekananda College Delhi Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) positions at Vivekananda College Delhi is 10th September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) post in Commerce at Vivekananda College Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required is as per UGC Regulations, 2018 and as adopted by the University of Delhi/UGC. Specific details can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) position is 70 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for Vivekananda College Delhi Assistant Professor jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of Vivekananda College Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) positions will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Assistant Professor (Guest Faculty) positions is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Vivekananda College Delhi?
faq.answer: The official website of Vivekananda College Delhi is www.vivekanandacollege.edu.in. You can visit this site for more information and to apply.
